structured.answer: I'm not deciding anything; I'll ask my son. Harel's investment plan tracks cost about half a percent a year, and the safest-sounding one, "כספי (שקלי)", earned 4.25% a year over 3 years. But nothing tells me whether that beats my deposit or is as safe, and many tracks show no return at all.
